intro: Plush comfort or firm support - the Dual Magic Plus let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Quilted finish for softness you can feel
features.text: Indulge in luxury every night—premium quilted fabric not only elevates your bedroom’s style but also adds a soft, cozy touch to your sleep.

features.title: Bonded foam provides balanced support
features.text: Your comfort matters—this mid-layer bonded foam core keeps you supported and steady, so you can relax without worrying about sinking in.

features.title: Built to endure everyday wear
features.text: Protect your investment with high-quality materials that not only extend your mattress’s lifespan but keep its comfort level intact year after year.

features.title: Perfect fit for your bed, every time
features.text: Our customisable dimensions ensure our mattress fits perfectly, no matter your bed’s size or shape—because your space deserves something made just for it.

name: Dual Magic Plus Single Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 36 X 5 Inches
